description: Daemon that runs signal discrimination audit against live mcp_signal_scores and mcp_signal_enrichments tables. Per spec section on signal quality: BAD SIGNAL = SAME SIGNAL across all inputs. Audit must verify distinct score count per signal_type across all servers. WEAK signals identified: permission_scope (3 distinct, range 30-100), temporal_stability (3 distinct, range 40-90), tool_description_safety (3 distinct, range 50-100). Produces audit JSON to log; does not modify database. Uses write_service :8772 for reads only.
